subject: Pre-commit checklist & CS handshake for Q3 upsell pool
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-commit checklist & CS handshake for Q3 upsell pool

Hi team,

As we lock the Q3 numbers, I need a quick operational sweep on the upsell pool — specifically the accounts we've flagged as expansion opportunities with close dates in Jul–Sep. Attached is the current commit matrix (Q3_upsell_commit_matrix.xlsx) with proposed ARR motions and current stage. Can CS run a health & gating check and return the following by EOD Wednesday (48 hours):

- Confirm account owner and whether the customer is in active negotiations or procurement pause
- Verified close date (MM/DD) and recommended commit probability (25/50/75/95)
- Any blockers that should reduce our committed ARR (legal, procurement, security reviews, exec approvals)
- Recommended mitigation (e.g., pricing concession, exec intro, SOW change)

Marissa — can you confirm the top-10 accounts you want Finance to include in the commit? Vivek — we’ll need a hard number for the forecast once CS signs off.

Goal: produce a cleaned commit file for Finance to ingest by Friday morning. If we need a short call to triage the top three, I can schedule a 30-min slot tomorrow.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-commit checklist & CS handshake for Q3 upsell pool

Thanks Priyom — got the matrix and noted the ask. Plan below:

1) CS will run the health check across the 18 accounts in the sheet and mark status: Green / Yellow / Red.
2) For any Yellow/Red, we’ll add one-line rationale and next action (pricing ask, legal hold, exec intro).
3) CS will validate close dates with the customer contact and flag any procurement/renewal windows that conflict.

I’ve started a quick review and already see Lumina Health may need a procurement sync — Elena Ruiz is looping procurement and prefers a finalized SOW before committing. I’ll reach out to Elena and suggest a 20-min pricing alignment call; copying the external contact below.

Proposed short cadence: CS returns the annotated matrix by Wed 6/9 COB. If any account needs an immediate escalation we’ll use the 30-min triage.

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-commit checklist & CS handshake for Q3 upsell pool

Monica — appreciate the quick turnaround. I updated the matrix with the latest internal notes and pre-filled proposed commit percentages for your review; attaching the revised file (Q3_upsell_commit_matrix.xlsx).

Elena — looping you in to confirm procurement timing and any required SOW language. We’ve also prepared a draft SOW (SOW_draft_Lumina_v2.pdf) that reflects the milestone-based delivery Lumina requested. If procurement prefers, we can convert the milestone payments to a single annual invoice.

Proposed short call: Wed 6/9 10:00–10:30 AM PT — CS + AE + Procurement to align pricing and SOW. Please confirm availability or propose alternate.

Action items (today):
- CS: validate the 18 accounts in sheet and return probability + notes by Wed COB.
- AE: flag any technical dependencies to product/infra that could impact timing.
- Finance: Vivek, if CS returns the verified numbers by Wed COB, can you accept a Friday final commit file for forecasting?

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-commit checklist & CS handshake for Q3 upsell pool

Thanks all — quick finance note: we can accept the Friday final file but need the commit column to be numeric (USD ARR) and a single line per account. I attached a one-row template (Q3_commit_template.csv) that maps to our ingestion pipeline. Please ensure:

- Final committed ARR for each account (do not include pipeline or best-case upsell)
- Any expected offsets (churn or contraction) included as negative lines with clear notes
- Final file submitted to the HubSpot deal link and cc'd to finance@redwood.ai

If CS hits any roadblocks that prevent Friday delivery, mark those accounts as “Not Ready” and include target remedial action. We will treat Not Ready as out of commit for the forecast.

If helpful, I can join the Wed 10:00 AM PT call to confirm numbers live.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of FP&A, Redwood Inference
